_comment: Passives v2 (earned perks). Loaded by PassiveTreeV2.load_default(), NOT by Defs; gated by balance.passives_v2_enabled. Points = 'marks'. requires_groups: every group needs >= n allocated ids from `any`. Numeric effects are read via PassiveTreeV2.mod(); keystone rule flags (effects `rule_<x>`: 1) via rules()/has_rule(). `excludes` = keystones that cannot coexist. See docs/gdd/03-colony/passives-v2/.

pit.name: The Pit
pit.blurb: Mining, hauling, building. The safe end of the sentence.

stacks.name: The Stacks
stacks.blurb: Refining essence. Every batch is a debt to the planet.

shop.name: The Shop
shop.blurb: Benches, files, ammo presses. Quality is the only thing the Warden cannot confiscate.

yard.name: The Yard
yard.blurb: Fists, shivs, rifles. What the waves teach.

infirmary.name: The Infirmary
infirmary.blurb: Rags, needles, calm voices. Keeping bodies and heads together.

ledger.name: The Ledger
ledger.blurb: Debt, Standing, suspicion, the Warden's favour. Politics of the block.

deeds.name: First Installment
deeds.text: Paid the Warden once. The ledger has a page with your name now.

stat_consumers.target_weight: sim/threats/threat_model.gd:496 pick (NEW: colonist score x (1+P), same hook traits v3 target_weight uses)

no_armor.rule: non-weapon slots refuse equip; worn pieces unequipped on allocate

mining_only.rule: work_tick x0.4 for every work type except mining

uncapped_contamination_per_batch.rule: the -0.4 floor on contamination_per_batch is skipped for this inmate

refine_strike.rule: takes no refinery operate job while planet contamination > 50 %

no_medicine.rule: tend() does nothing for him (others cannot tend him)

essence_heal.rule: injuries heal x3 while standing on tainted ground, x0 elsewhere

taint_immune.rule: tainted-ground exposure never makes him ill

quality_cap_common.rule: anything he crafts is capped at the lowest quality tier

craft_only.rule: job assignment offers only crafting / bench work types (draft still works)

no_downed.rule: downed state skipped: at the downed threshold he dies instead

rage.rule: damage dealt x (1 + 0.01 x max(0, 50 - mood)); x0.75 while mood > 50

field_tend.rule: his patients get the bed heal multiplier wherever they lie

no_draft.rule: set_drafted(c, true) refused; militia skips him

no_sleep.rule: rest never decays, sleep job never requested

night_breaks.rule: while clock.is_night(): thought night_terrors (-15) and the daily break roll runs x3 chance

no_installment.rule: installment size 0: never overdue, debt still accrues interest

always_informant.rule: _pick_informant chooses him while he is alive

off_roll.rule: no installments, no interest, pay() refused, covert sales add no suspicion, _confiscate skips his stash, Standing frozen

no_refinery.rule: operate giver never offers a refinery (work_type operating on a refining recipe)

taint_mining.rule: ore x2 when the mined cell is tainted; contamination +1 unit per 50 ore he mines

essence_craft.rule: every craft consumes +1 essence_ore and adds 0.25 batch of contamination

burns.rule: every 10th batch he finishes applies a burn injury (health kind burn, 10 % max hp)

melee_only.rule: weapon slot refuses ranged bases; shooting XP 0

ignore_pain.rule: can_act() always true, no injured thought, is_low_hp() false, never flees

medic.rule: on alarm he takes rescue/tend jobs instead of the flee override; a patient he carries stops bleeding

block_chaplain.rule: his block's despair_mult x0.5 while he is alive and not in a break (cached per day)
block_chaplain.hook: NEW: daily scan of block members

despair_frozen.rule: own despair never grows (same tag Hollow uses)

debt_in_hp.rule: on due day the installment is booked as paid and a 'letting' injury of 20 % max hp is applied; no essence consumed

ore_installment.rule: every 10 ore he mines books 1 unit of installment credit (no essence)

ore_skim.rule: 10 % of ore he mines goes to his contraband stash (rounded down per job)

raid_first.rule: _confiscate empties his stash before anyone else's

passives.name: Callouses
passives.desc: Hands that stopped bleeding weeks ago. Mining +10%.

passives.name: Yard Shoulders
passives.desc: Carries a quarter more per trip.

passives.name: Salvage Habit
passives.desc: Buildings cost 25% less and have +10% HP.

passives.name: Braced Walls
passives.desc: Buildings raised by this inmate have +20% HP.

passives.name: Beast of Burden
passives.desc: Carries anything in one trip. Wears no armour, walks 20% slower.
passives.rule: No carry cap: a haul takes the whole stack
passives.drawback: Cannot wear armour (non-weapon slots locked); move -20%

passives.name: Mole
passives.desc: Mines twice as fast, ore +50%. Every other job at 40% speed.
passives.rule: Mining x2 speed, ore +50%
passives.drawback: All non-mining work at 40% speed

passives.name: Valve Feel
passives.desc: Machines wear 20% slower under this operator.

passives.name: Slow Hands
passives.desc: Batches taint -60%, no cap. Half speed; downs tools above 50% taint.
passives.rule: His batches contaminate 60% less and ignore the -40% floor
passives.drawback: Operates at half speed; refuses refinery work while the planet is above 50% contamination

passives.name: Essence Lung
passives.desc: No medicine; heals x3 on tainted ground only. Creatures hunt him.
passives.rule: Cannot be tended; wounds heal x3 on tainted ground, not at all elsewhere; immune to taint sickness; operates +25%
passives.drawback: Creatures weight him x2 as a target

passives.name: Maker's Mark
passives.desc: Crafted gear is one quality tier higher.

passives.name: Steady File
passives.desc: Much better quality rolls; crafts 10% slower.

passives.name: Grease Monkey
passives.desc: Machines wear 40% slower under him; repairs +25%.

passives.name: Jury Rig
passives.desc: Repairs x3, machines never break under him. Crafts Common only.
passives.rule: Repairs x3; machines he operates never break
passives.drawback: Everything he crafts is Common; buildings he raises have -30% HP

passives.name: Signature Work
passives.desc: Every piece two tiers finer. Half speed; takes no other job.
passives.rule: Crafted gear +2 quality tiers, high rolls
passives.drawback: Crafts at half speed; accepts only crafting work

passives.name: Scar Tissue
passives.desc: Damage taken -15%; injuries hurt the mood half as much.

passives.name: Dead Man Walking
passives.desc: Never flees, never goes down: dies standing. Damage -30%. Mood -10.
passives.rule: Never flees; the downed state is skipped (fights until dead); damage taken -30%, hit +15%
passives.drawback: Dies where others would be downed; mood -10; heals 50% slower

passives.name: Short Fuse
passives.desc: Misery is ammunition: +1% damage per mood under 50. Breaks x2.
passives.rule: Damage x (1 + 1% per mood point below 50), up to +50%; x0.75 while mood > 50
passives.drawback: Breaks roll at twice the chance

passives.name: Thick Blood
passives.desc: Own wounds heal 40% faster, 25% fewer infections.

passives.name: Cast Iron
passives.desc: Hunger -20%, rests 20% faster, breaks 15% less often.

passives.name: Field Surgeon
passives.desc: Tends like a hospital anywhere; patients never infect. Will not fight.
passives.rule: His patients get the bed heal rate wherever they lie; tend +50%; no infections from his tending
passives.drawback: Cannot be drafted; hunger +30%

passives.name: White Nights
passives.desc: Never sleeps, works 50% faster. At night mood -15, breaks roll x3.
passives.rule: No rest need: never sleeps; all work +50%
passives.drawback: At night: thought -15 and the break roll runs at x3 chance

passives.name: Stash Pocket
passives.desc: Hides 3 more units of contraband; sales pay 10% more.

passives.name: Fence
passives.desc: Covert sales pay 30% more, stash +2; suspicion +10%.

passives.name: Trustee
passives.desc: Owes no installments; the Warden carries him. Always the informant.
passives.rule: Installments are zero (interest still grows); suspicion -50%
passives.drawback: He is the block informant whenever alive; earns no Standing; despair +50%

passives.name: Ghost on the Roll
passives.desc: Not on the roll: no dues, no suspicion, raids skip him. Can never pay.
passives.rule: No installments, no interest, his sales add no suspicion, shakedowns skip his stash; sales +25%
passives.drawback: Can never pay the debt off (no Paid in Full, no Submit payoff); earns no Standing

passives.name: Clean Hands Doctrine
passives.desc: Never touches a refinery. Ore +50%, mines in silence.
passives.rule: Ore +50%; his mining draws no creatures at all
passives.drawback: Takes no refinery job, ever

passives.name: Tailings Eater
passives.desc: Tainted rock yields double ore; no taint sickness. His ore poisons.
passives.rule: Ore x2 on tainted cells; immune to taint sickness
passives.drawback: Every 50 ore he mines adds 1 unit of contamination

passives.name: Essence Smith
passives.desc: Crafts with raw essence, two tiers finer. Each craft taints the world.
passives.rule: Crafted gear +2 tiers; input -20%
passives.drawback: Each craft eats 1 essence ore and adds a quarter batch of contamination

passives.name: Overclock
passives.desc: Machines run x2 under him, wear x4. Every tenth batch burns him.
passives.rule: Operate speed x2
passives.drawback: Machine wear x4; a burn injury every 10th batch

passives.name: Armourer's Pride
passives.desc: Armour counts double and never wears. Won't touch a gun.
passives.rule: Non-weapon gear totals x2; gear never wears
passives.drawback: Cannot equip ranged weapons; no shooting XP

passives.name: Full Auto
passives.desc: Never needs ammo, fires 25% faster. Every burst calls creatures.
passives.rule: Ammo use 0; attacks +25% faster
passives.drawback: Draws creatures x2; no melee XP

passives.name: Walking Wounded
passives.desc: Pain is nothing: wounds never slow him. Bleeds x2, never retreats.
passives.rule: Injuries never throttle his work; no injured thought; never retreats at low HP
passives.drawback: Bleeds twice as fast; never flees

passives.name: Stretcher Bearer
passives.desc: Runs toward the downed, not the shelter. Will never raise a weapon.
passives.rule: On alarm he rescues and tends instead of hiding; carried patients stop bleeding; move +20%
passives.drawback: Never attacks; cannot be drafted

passives.name: Chaplain
passives.desc: His block's despair halves while he lives. Learns nothing, works slow.
passives.rule: Block-wide: despair grows at half rate; his own never grows
passives.drawback: No XP in any skill; works 30% slower

passives.name: Blood Debt
passives.desc: Pays dues in blood: a wound each due day, no essence. Heals slower.
passives.rule: Installments are booked as paid and taken as a 20% max-HP wound; no essence
passives.drawback: Heals 30% slower; a downed inmate on due day misses the installment

passives.name: Quota Hawk
passives.desc: Every tenth ore pays the Warden directly. Mood -6, never hauls, loud.
passives.rule: 10 ore mined = 1 installment credit, no essence needed
passives.drawback: Never hauls or delivers; mood -6; draws creatures +30%

passives.name: Pocket Vein
passives.desc: Skims a tenth of his ore into his stash. Raids find him first.
passives.rule: 10% of ore he mines becomes contraband in his stash; stash +5
passives.drawback: Shakedowns empty his stash first; draws creatures +30%
